profile.name: Kevin
profile.oneLiner: I am a second-year student in an international program at HUIT, exploring Logistics, international business and entrepreneurship — while building my English, professional capabilities, an athletic lifestyle and personal discipline to create financial independence and a more flexible future.
profile.welcome: You have ambitions bigger than your current circumstances. Today is another chance to turn them into real skills, meaningful experiences and consistent action.

education.title: Education & career
items: Second-year student in an international program at HUIT.
Major: Logistics.
Exploring careers in Logistics, international business and multinational companies.
Curious how academic knowledge translates into real work experience.
Considering how education can support a future in entrepreneurship.

business.title: Entrepreneurial interests
items: Gym ownership and the fitness business.
Gym equipment distribution, including brands such as Panatta.
Supplement distribution and sales.
Fitness content creation and personal branding.
Business operations, supply chains, marketing and customer acquisition.

traits.title: Personal characteristics
items: Curious — always wants to understand the reasons behind things.
Values critical thinking and different perspectives.
Prefers concrete explanations and actionable plans.
Wants to grow in patience, communication and accountability.
Working on consistency, procrastination and overthinking.
Wants to become more approachable and socially confident.

vision.statement: To become financially independent, physically healthy, knowledgeable and emotionally resilient — able to support my family, build meaningful relationships and choose freely how I live.

career.title: Career & Business Development
career.target: Build practical experience and identify a meaningful career direction.
career.body: Explore Logistics and international business while developing the network, industry knowledge and entrepreneurial skills needed to enter the fitness industry or build an independent business.
career.track: Career research, internships, projects, mentors and business experiments.

english.title: English & Communication
english.body: Turn English from an academic subject into a professional advantage — for international opportunities, university performance, networking and business.
english.track: IELTS practice, grammar, vocabulary, writing and professional communication.

fitness.title: Fitness & Nutrition
fitness.target: Build a lean, athletic physique while keeping muscle and strength.
fitness.body: Build a sustainable fitness lifestyle through resistance training, cardiovascular conditioning, sensible nutrition and recovery.
fitness.track: Workouts, calories, protein, sleep and body-composition trends.
fitness.note: Previously stated plan: about {{normal}} kcal on normal/training days and {{rest}} kcal on rest days. Reassess periodically — not fixed requirements.

growth.title: Personal Growth & Life Management
growth.target: Develop consistency, emotional resilience, self-awareness, patience and better decision-making.
growth.body: Build a stronger mind and a balanced life by learning to manage emotions, relationships, responsibilities, habits and personal expectations.
growth.track: Daily priorities, emotional awareness, social confidence and monthly reflection.

career.title: Career Discovery & Entrepreneurship
career.body: Discover where your interests, strengths and market opportunities intersect — then turn that understanding into practical experience and potential business opportunities.

a.title: Logistics & International Business
bullets: Understand supply chains, procurement, freight forwarding and import-export.
Explore multinational companies and job opportunities in Vietnam and overseas.
Understand career progression, salary potential and the skills needed to become a business owner.

b.title: Fitness Industry & Business
bullets: Research gym equipment brands such as Panatta and how equipment is distributed.
Explore supplement distribution, sales, marketing and customer acquisition.
Study gym ownership and fitness content creation.

c.title: Professional Development & Networking
bullets: Find university lecturers, industry mentors and professionals.
Prepare a competitive CV and pursue internships.
Build a personal brand and sharpen professional communication.

english.title: English, Academic Excellence & Practical Skills
english.body: Develop strong communication and analytical skills so you can study internationally, work with confidence and express complex ideas clearly.

a.title: IELTS & Academic English
bullets: Improve Speaking toward Band 6.5–7.0.
Improve Writing toward Band 6.0–6.5.
Practise Task 2 argument development and coherence.

b.title: Language Foundation
bullets: Strengthen core grammar rather than memorising patterns.
Build vocabulary through context, synonyms, antonyms and collocations.
Use advanced but natural expressions.

c.title: Practical Communication
bullets: Practise presentations and spontaneous speaking.
Improve professional writing, emails and interviews.
Learn to explain ideas and convey different perspectives.

health.title: Physical Health, Mental Resilience & Relationships
health.body: Create a balanced lifestyle where physical health, emotional stability, meaningful relationships and personal discipline support one another.

a.title: Physical Development
bullets: Keep training at the gym and develop a V-shaped athletic physique.
Improve cardiovascular endurance through walking, running and Zone 2 work.
Prioritise protein, recovery and sleep.

b.title: Mental Strength
bullets: Develop a stable mindset instead of depending on motivation.
Cut back on body comparison and negative self-judgement.
Learn to handle uncertainty, anxiety and disappointment.

c.title: Social & Personal Development
bullets: Build genuine friendships and become more approachable.
Take responsibility in group projects and social commitments.
Develop patience, empathy, active listening and multi-perspective thinking.
